# An exact positivity obstruction to the literal generic-complex POVM lift

24 October 2026. Root construction; exact symbolic verification in the matching .py/.json. This is a failure of a proposed representation, not a separation theorem for information coefficients.

Take physical and original reference qubits A,R. Let sigma=(9/10)Phi_2+(1/10)I_4/4, with eigenvalues37/40 and1/40 (three times). Consider the strictly positive informationally complete POVM
E_(j,+/-)=(I +/- sigma_j/2)/6, j=X,Y,Z.
All effects have floor1/12 and their complex linear span is M_2.

Suppose a proposed top state G on A tensor R tensor R' is required to produce, for every measurement outcome, the arithmetic-mean Liouville baseline
Tr_A(E_i G)=[sigma_i tensor I+I tensor sigma_i^T]/(2r),
sigma_i=Tr_A(E_i sigma), r=2.

Informational completeness makes G unique: every physical matrix entry is fixed by the output constraints. The unique solution is
G=[sigma_AR tensor I_R' + Swap_(R,R')(sigma_AR^(T_R) tensor I_R')Swap_(R,R')]/(2r).
The transpose here is PARTIAL on R, not full on A,R. Full transpose would instead implement transposed effects and would not satisfy the required outputs for the Y effects.

The exact spectrum of this forced G is
1/8 (multiplicity4),
1/8-9sqrt(3)/80 (multiplicity2),
1/8+9sqrt(3)/80 (multiplicity2).
The middle eigenvalue is strictly negative. Thus no positive top state on this specified space can meet all these exact output arithmetic-mean constraints, even though the original input and all POVM effects are uniformly faithful.

The matching code verifies all six output identities symbolically, the effect-span rank4, the exact faithful input spectrum, and the exact negative lift eigenvalues. Recorded execution .05264seconds, Linux peakRSS46664KiB. These are observed checking costs, not total discovery costs.

What does NOT follow: complete-Umegaki and conditional/SLD orders differ for this POVM; no such coefficient gap has been proved. ## Exact uniqueness and transpose convention

The six effects E_(j,+/-)=(I +/- sigma_j/2)/6 span M_2 over the complex numbers: their sums span I and their differences span X,Y,Z. Consequently specifying Tr_A(E_i G) for every outcome fixes every physical operator block of G. The forced solution for target outputs

    B_i*=[sigma_i tensor I + I tensor sigma_i^T]/(2r)

is exactly the displayed formula using sigma^(T_R). Partial transpose on R commutes with the physical effect contraction, so Tr_A[E_i sigma^(T_R)]=sigma_i^T. Full transpose instead replaces E_i by E_i^T and fails for the Y effects.

For sigma=.9 Phi_2+.1 I_4/4, Pauli expansion and a local Y conjugation put the forced G in the form

    I_8/8 + (.9/16) sum_j sigma_j^A (sigma_j^(R')-sigma_j^R).

The coupling has spectrum 0 with multiplicity4 and +/-2sqrt(3) each with multiplicity2. This reproduces the exact negative eigenvalues 1/8-9sqrt(3)/80. The input and every POVM effect remain strictly positive.

## Larger references with a common CP extraction do not repair this target

Suppose a larger-reference positive state is followed by any common trace-preserving completely positive reference map to HS(R). Such a reference map commutes with every physical measurement effect. The extracted state would therefore be a positive trace-one G on the original specified target space satisfying the same output constraints, contradicting uniqueness and negativity.

The statement also excludes exact common positive compression/extraction when its nonzero common normalization is fixed. It does not address arbitrary outcome-dependent processing or a different realization that preserves only the desired metric ratios.
